notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deep Forest Hermit, adding {1}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Deep Forest Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Squirrel tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.
